statement: In the regular hyperbolic {4,5} tessellation there is no edge-connected polyform of exactly 16 tiles with exactly two bounded complementary components. Consequently, using the published 17-tile construction, g_{4,5}(2)=17.
contribution: This closes the one-unit endpoint left open in arXiv:2603.18638v1. Equality in its perimeter bound reduces any 16-tile example to deleting two singleton holes from an 18-tile extremal animal; C_{4,5}(2) is shown exactly to have 18 tiles, published Theorem 6.4 makes it the unique extremal animal at that size, and its only two interior tiles are adjacent, so they produce one cavity rather than two.
